sourceDirection: D10 locally verified incumbent-preserving procedure substitution
evidenceBoundary: All 76 questions were already consumed by D9 and D10. This diagnostic can choose D11 construction and bounds but cannot support confirmation, promotion, or a test claim.
hypothesis: A capsule may replace exact same-trajectory Base items only when it retains every bounded semantic UI value from those items verbatim, every D10 safe anchor, and the full bounded locally verified action skeleton inside the exact removed-item token budget. Otherwise it returns exact Base.

exit.borrowedPrinciple: Use extractive evidence, retain source order, and decline rather than generate an unsupported compression.

recomp.borrowedPrinciple: Separate compression from retrieval and permit a null augmentation action.

informationPreservation.borrowedPrinciple: Evaluate retained details and grounding in addition to compression and downstream utility; fine-grained entities and values are common compression failures.
